text:
deploybot: preflight check failed for rollout v2026-03-20. Rule: SECRET_NAMESPACE_MISMATCH. blocking promotion to prod
alice: ah, saw this on staging check earlier, weird path difference
bob_sre: can you paste the failing diff from the check?
deploybot: diff snippet:
```
expected (prod): secrets path = project/main/credentials
observed (staging): secrets path = project/staging/credentials
rule: namespace must be identical across envs
```
carol: @alice did the chart values for the credentials path get templated with {{ .Values.envName }} in the merge earlier?
alice: yep, PR #412 added envName interpolation to charts/core-auth. I thought it was gated by a flag but looks like default=true now
dave_platform: hold the rollout. if we promote with different secret paths prod will fail to load keys (seen that before).
emma_security: also a compliance concern — secret audit tooling expects canonical path `project/main/*`. If we create scattered namespaces we'll lose traceability.
frank_release: what's the quick mitigation? patch chart and re-run deploycheck? or pin the release to older chart?
bob_sre: quickest safe path: pin the chart version in the release manifest to the previous tag, skip promotion until we backfill staging or revert chart change.
alice: I'll open a rollback PR to remove envName interpolation and revert values to `project/main/credentials`. sending link in a sec.
deploybot: note: release promotion currently halted by policy:env-parity at 1753214321. To unblock: push new commit with chart fix or add explicit `secretPathOverride: project/main/credentials` in release values.
carol: manual override is fine for hotfix but prefer revert+followup PR to keep templates consistent.
dave_platform: agree. Frank — mark release window blocked and notify PMs.
frank_release: done — updated release notes with HOLD: env-parity secret namespace mismatch. pinging @product for FYI.
emma_security: after we fix, run `scripts/secret-audit.sh --env prod --path project/main` and attach the report to the release ticket.
alice: PR #418 created: revert envName interpolation. will request reviews from @carol and @emma.
bob_sre: once merged, I'll re-run deploycheck and post the new deploybot result here.
deploybot: deploycheck queued by bob_sre at 1753214401 — will report back. :gear: 
frank_release: thanks all — keeping change window blocked until parity verified. :lock:
